title: Ephesians 6:11 (KJV):
paragraphs:
Ephesians 6:11 (KJV):
“Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.”

Paul is telling us that the Christian life is not a playground. It is a battlefield. You do not drift into victory. You dress for war. The “whole armor” means God has already provided what you need, but you must put it on. Daily. Deliberately. No borrowed strength. No half-dressed holiness.

And notice this: the verse does not say if the enemy schemes. It says he does. The devil works through lies, temptation, fear, accusation, compromise, distraction. Quiet traps. Polished traps. Religious-looking traps.
But here’s the hope: God did not leave you exposed.

In Christ, you are not defenseless.
Truth guards you.
Righteousness covers you.
Faith shields you.
Salvation secures you.
The Word arms you.

Not in your willpower.
Not in your emotions.
In the Lord.
